import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import java.util.StringTokenizer

private const val MOD: Long = 998244353L

fun modAdd(a: Long, b: Long): Long {
    var res = a + b
    if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD
    return res
}

fun modMul(a: Long, b: Long): Long = (a * b) % MOD

fun main() {
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val n = br.readLine().trim().toInt()
    if (n == 1) {
        println(1)
        return
    }

    val adj = Array(n) { ArrayList<Int>() }
    repeat(n - 1) {
        val st = StringTokenizer(br.readLine())
        val u = st.nextToken().toInt() - 1
        val v = st.nextToken().toInt() - 1
        adj[u].add(v)
        adj[v].add(u)
    }

    // dp[v][state][k]
    // state: 0 = unmatched, 1 = matched to parent, 2 = matched to child
    // k: 0 = unique, 1 = multiple
    val dp = Array(n) { Array(3) { LongArray(2) } }
    val visited = BooleanArray(n)

    fun dfs(v: Int, p: Int) {
        visited[v] = true
        var children = ArrayList<Int>()
        for (to in adj[v]) {
            if (to == p) continue
            dfs(to, v)
            children.add(to)
        }

        if (children.isEmpty()) {
            // leaf
            dp[v][0][0] = 1L // unmatched, unique
            dp[v][1][0] = 1L // matched to parent, unique
            dp[v][2][1] = 0L // cannot be matched to child
            return
        }

        // Precompute products for unmatched state
        var prod0 = 1L
        var prod1 = 1L
        var prod2 = 1L
        var prod3 = 1L
        var anyMulti0 = false
        var anyMulti1 = false
        var anyMulti2 = false
        var anyMulti3 = false

        for (c in children) {
            val a0 = dp[c][0][0]
            val a1 = dp[c][0][1]
            val b0 = dp[c][2][0]
            val b1 = dp[c][2][1]

            val s0 = modAdd(a0, b0)
            val s1 = modAdd(a1, b1)

            // unmatched, unique: all children unique and choose unique options
            prod0 = modMul(prod0, s0)
            if (a1 != 0L || b1 != 0L) anyMulti0 = true

            // unmatched, multiple: at least one child multiple or multiple choices
            prod1 = modMul(prod1, modAdd(s0, s1))
            if (s1 != 0L) anyMulti1 = true

            // for matched to parent: children cannot be matched to parent
            val t0 = dp[c][0][0]
            val t1 = dp[c][0][1]
            val u0 = dp[c][2][0]
            val u1 = dp[c][2][1]

            val r0 = modAdd(t0, u0)
            val r1 = modAdd(t1, u1)

            prod2 = modMul(prod2, r0)
            if (t1 != 0L || u1 != 0L) anyMulti2 = true

            prod3 = modMul(prod3, modAdd(r0, r1))
            if (r1 != 0L) anyMulti3 = true
        }

        // unmatched state
        dp[v][0][0] = if (!anyMulti0) prod0 else 0L
        dp[v][0][1] = if (anyMulti0) prod1 else (prod1 + MOD - prod0) % MOD

        // matched to parent state
        dp[v][1][0] = if (!anyMulti2) prod2 else 0L
        dp[v][1][1] = if (anyMulti2) prod3 else (prod3 + MOD - prod2) % MOD

        // matched to child state
        var totalUnique = 0L
        var totalMulti = 0L

        for (c in children) {
            val a0 = dp[c][1][0]
            val a1 = dp[c][1][1]

            if (a0 == 0L && a1 == 0L) continue

            var prodChild0 = 1L
            var prodChild1 = 1L
            var anyMultiChild0 = false
            var anyMultiChild1 = false

            for (d in children) {
                if (d == c) continue
                val t0 = dp[d][0][0]
                val t1 = dp[d][0][1]
                val u0 = dp[d][2][0]
                val u1 = dp[d][2][1]

                val s0 = modAdd(t0, u0)
                val s1 = modAdd(t1, u1)

                prodChild0 = modMul(prodChild0, s0)
                if (t1 != 0L || u1 != 0L) anyMultiChild0 = true

                prodChild1 = modMul(prodChild1, modAdd(s0, s1))
                if (s1 != 0L) anyMultiChild1 = true
            }

            val uniqChild = if (!anyMultiChild0) prodChild0 else 0L
            val multiChild = if (anyMultiChild0) prodChild1 else (prodChild1 + MOD - prodChild0) % MOD

            val uniqWays = modMul(a0, uniqChild)
            val multiWays = (modMul(a1, uniqChild) + modMul(modAdd(a0, a1), multiChild)) % MOD

            totalUnique = modAdd(totalUnique, uniqWays)
            totalMulti = modAdd(totalMulti, multiWays)
        }

        dp[v][2][0] = totalUnique
        dp[v][2][1] = totalMulti
    }

    dfs(0, -1)

    val root = 0
    val ansUnique = (dp[root][0][0] + dp[root][2][0]) % MOD
    val ansMulti = (dp[root][0][1] + dp[root][2][1]) % MOD
    val ans = (ansUnique + ansMulti) % MOD
    println(ans)
}

Write a program in Kotlin to solve this programming problem:
Description: Vasya has got a tree consisting of $$$n$$$ vertices. He wants to delete some (possibly zero) edges in this tree such that the maximum matching in the resulting graph is unique. He asks you to calculate the number of ways to choose a set of edges to remove.A matching in the graph is a subset of its edges such that there is no vertex incident to two (or more) edges from the subset. A maximum matching is a matching such that the number of edges in the subset is maximum possible among all matchings in this graph.Since the answer may be large, output it modulo $$$998244353$$$.
Input Specification: The first line contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of vertices in the tree. Each of the next $$$n − 1$$$ lines contains two integers $$$u$$$ and $$$v$$$ ($$$1 \le u, v \le n, u \neq v$$$) denoting an edge between vertex $$$u$$$ and vertex $$$v$$$. It is guaranteed that these edges form a tree.
Output Specification: Print one integer — the number of ways to delete some (possibly empty) subset of edges so that the maximum matching in the resulting graph is unique. Print the answer modulo $$$998244353$$$.

Sample Input:
4
1 2
1 3
1 4
Sample Output:
4

Sample Input:
4
1 2
2 3
3 4
Sample Output:
6

Sample Input:
1
Sample Output:
1

Notes: NotePossible ways to delete edges in the first example:   delete $$$(1, 2)$$$ and $$$(1, 3)$$$.  delete $$$(1, 2)$$$ and $$$(1, 4)$$$.  delete $$$(1, 3)$$$ and $$$(1, 4)$$$.  delete all edges.
